parsed.why: No criminalisation or documented targeting, but no gender-identity protection, no document remedy, general stigma and thin monitoring; mismatch at inspections is an open question, not a documented exposure.

2023 decriminalisation, police-protected Pride, welcoming lodging, region-friendly polls; offset by no legal recognition, gender-identity-unnamed protections, election hate speech and the 2018 death-threat cancellation.

Parent's gender-identity protections, hate-crime aggravation and marker reform apply locally, but recurring custody placement of trans women in men's facilities and stigma/concealment in an isolated community pull it down.

Constitutional gender-identity protection with zero implementation, religious and political threat-framing, a documented trans killing and police distrust deterring hate-crime reports; cultural third-gender acceptance is only a partial offset.

Comprehensive trans statute, self-declaration recognition, custody placement by choice, conviction for the 2025 killing; offset by high documented violence prevalence, short trans life expectancy and uneven service-discrimination enforcement.
